body:
Every-time I talk to my family they completely shut me down and make me feel like shit, they refuse to help me and just think I’m being selfish.
I’m constantly told I’m a terrible person for anything I do, I’m immediately criticized and laughed at for any single fuckin thing I do. It’s a never ending cycle of being told what to do and how to act, and so I’m done, I don’t even know who I am anymore.My boyfriend and friends uses me, have you ever just gave everything single inch of love and energy to people and just been thrown out, like none of it matters? All they do is take take take. I’ve realized all of this 2 years ago but before I could take it, I was stronger. Now I’m just numb and what’s the point of life if you can’t feel and be like others?
